hypothesis: A subset of strict profile-supported recruitment links may reflect only short shared regions in otherwise long proteins. Removing those links before graph refinement may improve family coherence and downstream reconciliation. Coverage is evidence, not proof of orthology; fragment-like and fusion/fission-compatible asymmetry must not be automatically rejected.
control: Unweighted canonical high_sensitivity, fixed initial min4/cap100, BLOSUM62, CPM0.1/seed4, one strict MSA-profile pass, existing in-sample self thresholds and sequence anchors, default refinement, satellite_v2, inferred min_variance species tree, species_overlap/positive_paralogy, legacy support mapping. The guard is independent of the weighting intervention; do not combine them at this stage.
algorithm: Extend the existing integer three-state banded local Viterbi recurrence with start/end coordinates and a count of match-state steps with a known target amino acid. Use the same emissions, transitions, band64 and short-sequence full-band rule. This is an extension of OrthoHMM's existing scorer, not a new Plan7 implementation, Forward probability or alignment posterior.

Specify a deterministic representative optimal path: local restart before a tied zero predecessor; then M/I/D preference for match predecessors; opening before extension for tied gap predecessors; first row-major strict maximum for the terminal match state. Different equally scoring paths can have different spans. Record this limitation and do not choose paths using benchmark labels or desired acceptance.

Refactor existing strict recruitment selection into an internal helper retaining candidate gene, selected profile, selected sequence anchor and original anchor score. Default off must reproduce original edge bytes, duplicate handling and tie rules. Do not alter profile construction, eligible hits, best-profile selection, sequence-anchor selection, thresholds, initial search or candidate budgets.

For each selected candidate/profile pair with a sequence anchor, selectively recompute the extended Viterbi record. Require its raw integer score to exactly equal the retained profile-hit score. Stop on mismatch rather than silently using a proxy alignment, changing thresholds or substituting a score.

Record zero-based half-open model and target coordinates, model/target lengths, score and matched-known-residue count. Keep bounding-span coverage and aligned-residue coverage separate: a long deletion or insertion is not aligned evidence. Aligned model coverage is matched-known count/model length; aligned target coverage is matched-known count/full target length. Unknown target residues contribute no aligned evidence.

The sole guard is max(aligned model coverage, aligned target coverage) >=0.8, evaluated by the exact integer condition 5*matched_known_count >=4*min(model_length,target_length), with positive lengths. Remove the selected anchor link only when the condition fails. Do not switch to another profile or anchor, add links, expand the candidate cap, or impose identical domain architecture.

Record categories: both sides covered, asymmetric coverage, partial shared region, no positive alignment, and invalid/score mismatch. These are evidence categories, not asserted biological truth. Asymmetric coverage retains legitimate fragment-like cases and may also include fusion/fission or a complete short shared domain; it is not sufficient to diagnose these events. Preserve original complete OG/pair semantics and use these annotations to inform the separately evaluated local-tree method.

implementation.span_backend: Opt-in Numba extension of the existing banded recurrence, with bounded linear target-length workspace. Preserve all three original CPU scoring libraries and the existing scoring path.
implementation.interface: profile_alignment_policy API/CLI/replay option off or strict_span_guard, default off. Require active built-in high_sensitivity profile inference; reject ignored/incompatible requests. Record actual activation, candidates traced, accepted/rejected links and per-candidate evidence.
implementation.resource_bounds: Trace only already selected strict candidate/profile anchors, not all millions of initial or profile candidates. Use the run's CPU budget and one new scientific inference job at a time.
implementation.runner: benchmark_tools/run_profile_weighting_pilot.py prepare --experiment alignment selects this separate protocol and off/strict_span_guard arms. The legacy weighting interface remains the default. The shared runtime applies identical native/control/scoring gates and independently recounts nonempty alignment evidence, source-profile membership, coordinate/count consistency, coverage categories and retained unique-edge counts. Queue biological execution only after weighting job24477 is terminal.

stages: Unit-test hand-computed spans, empty/unknown cases, insertions/deletions, restart and tie rules, sequence/model coordinate bounds and matched counts. Verify raw integer score equality with existing Numba and original C scoring over varied lengths, bands and adversarial profiles; retain exact score-mismatch failures.

Use synthetic full-length homologs, fragments, two long proteins sharing a short domain, fusions/fissions and repeats to validate evidence classification. This checks specified behavior, not biological generalization or tuned benchmark accuracy. No post-result threshold search.
Test default edge-byte compatibility and actual end-to-end opt-in activation, serial/parallel equivalence, CLI/API guards, diagnostics, invariant gene ownership and retained unknown/ambiguous cases.

After the currently running weighting panel is terminal, freeze tested guard source and prepare a fresh two-arm complete-proteome OrthoBench downstream replay from the authenticated canonical initial hits. Revalidate off against retained canonical control and rebuild changed profiles/graphs/candidates/trees. Reuse only exact-compatible unchanged tree caches with explicit provenance.

Independently validate native products and score OrthoBench P/R/F1. Advance only if F1 strictly improves and neither precision nor recall falls by more than0.005. On failure, close this arm without retuning, retain its negative result and proceed to local-tree rescue and selective HMMER validation.

If advanced, apply unchanged settings to corrected QfO and Three Kingdoms. Report the complete eight-endpoint vector, population/resource diagnostics and defensible paired-family uncertainty. Preserve explicit NA for unrun endpoints, development exposure, unseeded FAS limitations and independent-confirmation gaps. No automatic default promotion.

resources.timing: Shared-host incremental replay/cache timing, not isolated full-pipeline timing

git: Commit and push this detailed protocol before intervention code/evaluation, then tested implementation, frozen execution manifest and verified result/decision milestones. Preserve the running weighting source and all unrelated user files.
